synthesis.headline: 98% of high-skepticism readers react negatively because they demand guaranteed APY floors and third-party verification before trusting yield claims.

findings.claim: 98% of high-skepticism readers react negatively because they demand guaranteed APY floors and third-party verification before trusting yield claims.
86% of low-tech-comfort readers react negatively because they cannot parse how FDIC pass-through works across moving cash and fear hidden fees.
90% of sub-$25k income readers react negatively because they need a guaranteed minimum return with zero fees to justify switching their emergency fund.

highest_leverage_edit.current_text: No teaser rate that drops after 90 days.
highest_leverage_edit.proposed_text: We guarantee a minimum 4.5% APY for the first 12 months, backed by an independent quarterly audit of all partner bank rates.
highest_leverage_edit.rationale: A concrete, audited APY floor for a full year, replacing a vague "no teaser" claim with a verifiable guarantee.

synthesis.who_you_are_losing: High-skepticism, low-tech-comfort, and lower-income savers who control the bulk of emergency-fund balances but won't move money without a guaranteed, audited APY floor.
synthesis.who_you_are_winning: Tech-comfortable, higher-income optimizers (e.g., p068, p081, p083, p023, p008) who already grasp yield arbitrage and will act on a credible rate advantage.
